title: Welcome, with "I was invited"
note: With server features on the door is back (D-100 amends D-087): Begin the book, and a quiet "I was invited" for a parent whose partner already started one.
text: The baby memory book you fill by talking. A few words at a time, in your own voice. Kept for your child to read and hear for years. Your first two letters are free. Begin the book I already have a book I was invited
